description: Delegate a task to a subagent and return its final answer. list returns the profiles and models available to start, with when to use each. start needs task and begins a fresh subagent with this conversation's profile and model, or with a listed profile and model when given. With fork=true it instead inherits this conversation up to the current user message, keeping its profile and model. continue sends a new task to an idle subagent by agent_id. inspect reports a subagent's working, settled (finished), and answer. With background=true, start and continue return the agent_id at once.

profile.description: Profile name from list; defaults to this conversation's profile; start only, excludes fork

model.description: Model name from list; defaults to this conversation's model; start only, excludes fork

fork.description: Inherit this conversation; start only, excludes profile and model

background.description: Return without waiting for the answer; start or continue only

task.description: Instructions for the subagent; required for start and continue

agent_id.description: Subagent from an earlier start; required for inspect and continue
